exercises.instruction: Choose the best answer according to the vocabulary and contexts in Unit 5.

questions.question: A virtual choir makes it possible for ordinary people ______ together online.
questions.explanation: enable/make it possible for sb to do sth；课文描述人们在线合唱。

questions.question: The videos are uploaded ______ the Internet and put together into one video.
questions.explanation: upload sth onto the Internet。

questions.question: Eric Whitacre is an award-winning ______ and conductor.
questions.explanation: composer 是“作曲家”；conductor 是“指挥”。

questions.question: The virtual choir has become a worldwide ______.
questions.explanation: a worldwide phenomenon；单数名词前有 a。

questions.question: Music gave Sarah a sense of ______.
questions.explanation: a sense of satisfaction 是固定搭配。

questions.question: The aim ______ the festival is to raise money for charity.
questions.explanation: the aim of sth。

questions.question: He is capable ______ writing original compositions.
questions.explanation: be capable of doing sth。

questions.question: The girl was moved ______ his romantic words.
questions.explanation: be moved by...；过去分词作表语/状语的课文语法语境。

exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.

questions.question: The singer gave an excellent ______ at the school festival. (perform)
questions.explanation: perform（动词）→ performance（名词）。

questions.question: The young ______ has written several original songs. (compose)
questions.explanation: compose → composer，表示作曲家。

questions.question: The audience were deeply ______ by the music. (move)
questions.explanation: be moved by；过去分词表示人的感受。

questions.question: The band performed ______ on the stage. (energy)
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 performed，使用副词 energetically。

questions.question: Music had a great ______ on her life. (impact)
questions.explanation: have an impact on。

questions.question: The concert was a ______ success. (phenomenon)
questions.explanation: phenomenal 是形容词；注意 phenomenon 是名词。

questions.question: She has a real ______ for playing the piano. (talent)
questions.explanation: have a talent for doing sth。

questions.question: The teacher praised the students for their ______. (original)
questions.explanation: original → originality，表示独创性。

exercises.instruction: Use the phrases in the box. Change the form if necessary: fall in love with; from then on; get through; in addition to; set up; try out; be absorbed in; be capable of.

questions.question: The students will ______ the sound equipment before the music festival.
questions.explanation: set up equipment：搭建/安装设备。

questions.question: Many students want to ______ as performers.
questions.explanation: try out as a performer：参加表演者选拔。

questions.question: She ______ classical music when she first heard Mozart.
questions.explanation: fall in love with 的过去式是 fell。

questions.question: ______ singing, volunteers can also help sell tickets.
questions.explanation: in addition to 后接名词或动名词。

questions.question: Music helped him ______ the difficult period.
questions.explanation: get through difficult times：熬过艰难时期。

questions.question: He was ______ the music and did not hear the bell.
questions.explanation: be absorbed in：全神贯注于。

exercises.instruction: Translate the following sentences into English using the expressions from Unit 5.

questions.question: 虚拟合唱团使普通人能够通过互联网一起唱歌。
questions.answer: A virtual choir enables ordinary people to sing together over the Internet.
questions.explanation: enable sb to do sth；ordinary people；virtual choir。

questions.question: 从那时起，她开始对古典音乐产生兴趣。
questions.answer: From then on, she began to take an interest in classical music.
questions.explanation: from then on 表示从过去某个时间开始。

questions.question: 音乐对我的生活产生了很大的影响。
questions.answer: Music has had a great impact on my life.
questions.explanation: have an impact on。

questions.question: 除了弹钢琴，他还会演奏一种弦乐器。
questions.answer: In addition to playing the piano, he can play a stringed instrument.
questions.explanation: in addition to 后接动名词。

questions.question: 沉浸在音乐中帮助她度过了那段艰难时期。
questions.answer: Being absorbed in music helped her get through that difficult time.
questions.explanation: be absorbed in；get through。

exercises.instruction: Complete or identify the structure based on Unit 5.

questions.question: Rewrite using a past participle: The girl was moved by the music, so she began to dance.
questions.answer: Moved by the music, the girl began to dance.
questions.explanation: 过去分词短语作状语，表示原因/状态。

questions.question: Identify the rhetorical device: “My spirits flew like a kite in the wind.”
questions.explanation: 用 like 引出明显比较。

questions.question: Identify the rhetorical device: “Music became my best friend.”
questions.explanation: 把音乐写成能成为朋友的人。

questions.question: Identify the rhetorical device: “It was the rock I leant on.”
questions.explanation: 把音乐比作可以依靠的岩石/支撑。

questions.question: What is the purpose of repeating “Music gave me...” in the speech?
questions.answer: repetition（重复），用于强调音乐带来的多种积极影响。
questions.explanation: 重复句式增强节奏感和强调效果。
